title: SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.26601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based agents are becoming increasingly capable at discovering, validating and patching vulnerabilities in real software, and vendors and researchers report that this is already changing how vulnerabilities are found and fixed. These claims, however, are scattered across papers, vendor reports and disclosures and are rarely comparable. We introduce a framework that rates these capabilities on an autonomy scale modeled on the levels of driving automation, and qualifies each claim by its correctness, its availability and the strength of its evidence. We use this framework to systematize the published evidence on LLM capability in vulnerability research. We find that agents discovered, validated, and patched vulnerabilities in real-world software without human intervention before the restricted frontier models of 2026, and that open-weight models subsequently attained comparable autonomy for discovery and validation. translated_title: SoK：评估大语言模型在软件漏洞研究中能力的演进
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在发现、验证和修补真实软件漏洞方面的能力日益增强，厂商和研究人员报告称这已经在改变漏洞被发现和修复的方式。然而，这些说法散见于论文、厂商报告和披露信息中，鲜有可比性。我们引入了一个框架，借鉴自动驾驶自动化分级模型，在自主性等级尺度上对这些能力进行评级，并通过其正确性、可获得性以及证据强度对每项说法加以限定。我们利用该框架对已发表的关于LLM漏洞研究能力的证据进行了系统化梳理。我们发现，在2026年受限的前沿模型出现之前，智能体已经能够在无需人工干预的情况下发现、验证并修补真实世界软件中的漏洞，而开源权重模型随后在发现和验证方面也达到了相当的自主性水平。随后我们测量了……
tldr: 本文提出一个借鉴自动驾驶分级的自主性评级框架，系统化梳理了LLM在漏洞研究中的能力证据，发现2026年前智能体已能在无人工干预下发现、验证并修补真实软件漏洞，开源权重模型随后也达到了相当的自主性水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an autonomy rating framework modeled on driving automation levels to systematize evidence on LLM capability in vulnerability research, finding that agents already discovered, validated, and patched real-world software vulnerabilities without human intervention before 2026's restricted frontier models, with open-weight models subsequently achieving comparable autonomy.
